requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简单的菜单式显示系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3、DHT11（D7）和电位器 A0。D2 用于切换菜单项，D3 用于确认；菜单包括显示温度、显示湿度、显示电位器值三项，确认后持续显示对应值直到再次切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Hold D3 pressed edge to confirm initial menuIndex; keep io_4 true with stable io_2/io_3/io_5; keep D2 not pressed; observe io_6 over several control steps.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: After D3 rising edge, io_6 equals floor(io_2) when confirmedIndex==0 and remains unchanged while D2 has no rising edges, regardless of menuIndex changes.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简单的菜单式显示系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3、DHT11（D7）和电位器 A0。D2 用于切换菜单项，D3 用于确认；菜单包括显示温度、显示湿度、显示电位器值三项，确认后持续显示对应值直到再次切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With confirmedIndex already set (by a prior D3 rising edge) and io_4 true, press D2 to generate two successive rising edges; do not press D3.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_6 does not change after D2 presses alone; it changes only on D3 rising edges by copying menuIndex into confirmedIndex.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简单的菜单式显示系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3、DHT11（D7）和电位器 A0。D2 用于切换菜单项，D3 用于确认；菜单包括显示温度、显示湿度、显示电位器值三项，确认后持续显示对应值直到再次切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Drive D2 rising edges three times (0->1->2->0) while generating a D3 rising edge after each D2 rising edge; keep io_4 true and set distinct io_2/io_3/io_5 values.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: After each D3 rising edge, io_6 equals floor(io_2) for confirmedIndex==0, floor(io_3) for confirmedIndex==1, and floor(io_5) for confirmedIndex==2, matching the selected menu item.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简单的菜单式显示系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3、DHT11（D7）和电位器 A0。D2 用于切换菜单项，D3 用于确认；菜单包括显示温度、显示湿度、显示电位器值三项，确认后持续显示对应值直到再次切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set confirmedIndex to temperature (menuIndex==0 then D3 rising). Then set io_4=false while keeping io_2/io_3 possibly changed, and keep D2/D3 not pressed.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: When confirmedIndex==0 and io_4 is false, io_6 becomes 0 and remains 0 until either io_4 becomes true again or confirmedIndex changes via D3.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个简单的菜单式显示系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3、DHT11（D7）和电位器 A0。D2 用于切换菜单项，D3 用于确认；菜单包括显示温度、显示湿度、显示电位器值三项，确认后持续显示对应值直到再次切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set confirmedIndex to humidity (menuIndex==1 then D3 rising). Toggle io_4 from true to false and then back to true without pressing D2 or D3.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On io_4=false, io_6 becomes 0; on io_4=true, io_6 returns to floor(io_3) for humidity while confirmedIndex remains humidity.
